description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM leave API module. The class models leave data, including properties like leave ID, date, duration, status, leave request info, leave type, start/end times, duration type, and last comment details. It utilizes traits and annotations for serialization, filtering, and documentation purposes.

classes.name: LeaveModel
classes.description: A model class representing leave information in the HRM system, incorporating properties for leave details, status, type, timeframe, and comments, with serialization and filtering configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveModel with a Leave entity, setting up filtering attributes and attribute names for serialization.
